style_name: Signal Red Petal Profile Editorial Cover
style_summary: A maximal independent-magazine cover system built from a fragmented signal-red masthead, one monumental flat-color side-profile portrait, a sparse off-white editorial rail, and a huge right-heavy mantle of overlapping cobalt, coral, and hot-pink petal lobes. Multiple typographic voices, a single black burst, tiny drawn ephemera, and restrained uncoated-paper texture create a cheeky fashion-editorial rhythm without copying any real publication or person.

environment_variables.SUBJECT: main illustrated subject
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: subtle profile action or focal gesture
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: one small case-specific object or line-art vignette
environment_variables.LOCATION: abstract editorial setting or thematic context
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: two to four restrained case-specific marginal details
environment_variables.MAIN_TEXT: fictional masthead word and primary feature headline, supplied as labeled text
environment_variables.SECONDARY_TEXT: deck, burst label, issue marker, and footer note, supplied as labeled text
environment_variables.ACCENT_SYMBOL: one fictional emblem or small graphic glyph
environment_variables.STYLE_FIDELITY_ANCHORS: observable style traits that must remain visible
environment_variables.SOURCE_CONTENT_TO_AVOID: literal source content that generated samples must not recreate

style_fidelity_anchors: A warm off-white uncoated-paper field supports an asymmetric independent-magazine cover rather than a centered poster or clean card layout.

A giant signal-red geometric masthead spans at least ninety percent of the top width, occupies roughly eighteen to twenty-two percent of the height, is cropped by the frame, and is split by one or two white horizontal cuts.
One monumental strict side-profile figure occupies the center-right and extends beyond the right and bottom edges; the head sits near the upper-middle rather than the center.
A narrow exposed-paper editorial rail occupies roughly one quarter to one third of the left side and carries several irregularly stacked text clusters rather than boxed modules.
The entire portrait is built from crisp flat vector or cut-paper color planes with no photoreal skin, modeled shading, cast shadows, glossy light, or universal black outline.

The garment creates a huge right-heavy silhouette from at least thirty overlapping teardrop, petal, scallop, wave, or ribbon lobes at three scales, with warm small lobes nearer the torso and larger cool lobes expanding rightward.

The palette uses about forty to forty-eight percent signal red, coral, pink, and orange; eighteen to twenty-four percent cobalt, royal blue, and dark teal; twenty-four to thirty-one percent warm paper; and five to nine percent black.

Five typographic registers coexist: widely tracked narrow italic kicker, fragmented geometric masthead, oversized condensed issue marker with stacked black sans, rough slab or typewriter feature heads with mono decks, and loose handwritten marginal notes.
The subject occludes roughly one quarter of the red masthead, while organic lobes invade the left rail below mid-height so the copy and illustration collide instead of forming separate columns.
One irregular black starburst with short reverse-white copy overlaps the colored lower-right mass; it never floats in unused paper space.

Supporting editorial ephemera stay deliberate and sparse: one case-specific pen-and-ink vignette, one fictional mini-emblem, one short non-scannable registration strip, and one baseline handwritten note.
The finish resembles clean spot inks on toothy stock with faint grain, subtle ink modulation, and mildly softened printed edges, never heavy grunge, noisy halftone, or distressed photocopy damage.
source_content_to_avoid: Erling Haaland, any recognizable footballer, athlete, celebrity, or likeness derived from the reference face.
The reference blond crown, dark tied bun, facial proportions, expression, angular pink sunglasses, or matching profile silhouette.
Football or soccer, stadiums, jerseys, trophies, World Cup imagery, sports statistics, athlete-celebrity storytelling, or the Viking-of-the-north premise.
The numeral nine as a dominant issue marker or any source issue numbering.
Norway's flag, national crest, football federation insignia, team badge, or any recognizable national or sports emblem.
The ESPN name, its exact masthead letterforms or cuts, and any other real magazine or media brand.
The phrases THE JOKER OF THE NORTH, UNSTOPPABLE, HAALAND DOCTRINE, KING OF THE NEW COLOSSEUM, AURA RECIPE, or any source cover line.
The exact feather boa, wing-like blue-and-pink costume, red jacket, oversized white shirt lettering, or source garment arrangement.
The source sneaker sketch, exact barcode, bottom-left badge, creator names, signature, footer joke, or microcopy.
The source starburst wording about genetics or shampoo and its exact coordinates or proportions.
A near-identical element-by-element reconstruction, including the same copy line breaks, doodle positions, accessory, or national identity cues.
Any watermark, username, platform logo, QR code, real scannable barcode, brand mark, creator ID, or signature.

visual_deconstruction.overall_style: Maximal flat-ink illustrated independent magazine cover with neo-pop color blocking, editorial marginalia, and fashion caricature energy.
visual_deconstruction.composition_logic: A rigid fragmented masthead and sparse left editorial rail collide with one organic, extremely cropped profile portrait whose lobed garment becomes the dominant right and lower color mass.
visual_deconstruction.subject_placement: The lateral profile faces into the left rail while its torso and mantle run beyond the right and bottom edges; the figure is never fully contained or centered.
visual_deconstruction.camera_and_perspective: Orthographic editorial side view with essentially no lens depth; scale and crop create monumentality rather than perspective or cinematic staging.
visual_deconstruction.typography_behavior: Five registers create hierarchy through radical scale contrast, compressed line spacing, deliberate collisions, and irregular vertical stacking instead of a single coherent font family.
visual_deconstruction.color_behavior: Warm red, coral, pink, and orange planes dominate the face, torso, and masthead; cobalt and royal blue accumulate into the outer-right mantle; warm paper and black organize the editorial rail.
visual_deconstruction.graphic_grammar: Fragmented megatype, angular facial planes, repeated organic lobes, one jagged burst, one invented emblem, one line-art object vignette, short registration bars, and handwritten footer notation.
visual_deconstruction.texture_and_finish: Mostly clean solid fills with subtle paper tooth, restrained screen-ink modulation, and faintly printed edges; no realism, gradients, glow, or material rendering.
visual_deconstruction.lighting: Flat and shadowless, with adjacent color planes doing all descriptive work rather than an environmental light source.
visual_deconstruction.mood: Cheeky, fashion-forward, rebellious, witty, and collectible, like an experimental culture magazine printed with vivid spot inks.

composition.ink_and_space: Keep total non-paper coverage near seventy to seventy-six percent, with visible paper concentrated in the narrow left rail and small seams around the masthead.
composition.masthead_zone: Span at least ninety percent of the top width with giant signal-red geometric letters, crop them at the sides, split them by one or two paper-white horizontal cuts, and let the head cover twenty to thirty-five percent of the lettering.
composition.hero_scale: The head and garment should carry at least sixty percent of the visual weight; the profile focal point sits near fifty-two percent width and twenty-eight to thirty-two percent height.
composition.left_rail: Reserve roughly twenty-nine to thirty-four percent width in portrait or twenty-four to thirty percent in landscape for an uneven spine of three to five headline and microcopy clusters; never draw a border or rectangular sidebar.
composition.organic_collision: Let warm small lobes cross into the rail below mid-height, then expand into larger cobalt and blue lobes toward the right edge; at least three lobes must be cropped by the right edge and the lower mass by the bottom edge.
composition.burst_position: Overlap one black jagged burst with the colored lower-right subject mass at roughly eighty-five percent width and eighty percent height; never center it or place it in empty paper.
composition.portrait_adaptation: For 4:5, keep a tall left editorial rail, three vertically stacked feature zones, a hero bounding box extending roughly from sixteen percent width to beyond the right edge, and a strong bottom crop.
composition.landscape_adaptation: For 5:4, keep one left editorial spine, compress it to the issue block plus two feature clusters, place the hero from roughly twenty-seven percent width to beyond the right edge, and crop the right lobe mass more aggressively instead of shrinking it.

typography.kicker: Use one narrow italic or oblique uppercase line with very wide tracking across eighty to ninety percent of the top width at a tiny scale.
typography.masthead: Render the fictional masthead as extremely heavy geometric grotesk megatype in signal red, cropped and segmented by white horizontal channels; do not imitate any real publication letterforms.
typography.issue_block: Use a single oversized condensed black issue marker other than nine beside a compact three- or four-line ultra-bold condensed sans title.
typography.feature_heads: Set two or three short all-caps feature headlines in a rough slab-serif or typewriter face with tight leading; pair them with narrow monospaced decks.
typography.handwriting: Add one compact hand-drawn note near the vignette and one small reverse-white handwritten baseline note across the lower colored area.
typography.legibility: Keep the masthead, issue marker, main feature headline, and starburst label correctly spelled and readable; tiny decks may be abbreviated but must not become glyph soup.

color_palette.warm_paper: #F5F2EA — exposed cover field, typographic cuts, and breathing seams
color_palette.signal_red: #FF1024 — fragmented masthead and selected garment planes
color_palette.coral: #FF6048 — face, neck, and inner garment planes
color_palette.cobalt: #1238C7 — outer mantle, deep facial planes, and cool mass
color_palette.dark_teal: #075848 — hair, contour details, and small cool accents
color_palette.marigold: #FFAA08 — restricted hair, jewelry, or emblem accent
color_palette.ink_black: #050505 — editorial type, line vignette, burst, and registration marks
color_palette.distribution: Approximately forty to forty-eight percent warm chroma, eighteen to twenty-four percent blue and teal, twenty-four to thirty-one percent warm paper, and five to nine percent black, with a warm-to-cool area ratio near two to one.

image_treatment.rendering_mode: Flat vector or cut-paper editorial illustration made from hard-edged spot-color planes and sparse local contour lines.
image_treatment.portrait_construction: Simplify the profile into angular interlocking facial, hair, and accessory shapes; retain expressive identity without realistic skin texture or airbrushed modeling.
image_treatment.lobe_system: Build the garment or mantle from at least thirty visibly separate scallop, petal, teardrop, waveform, leaf, or ribbon lobes at three scales; keep them abstract and case-specific rather than literal feathers.
image_treatment.edge_quality: Use crisp silhouettes with a slight uncoated-print softness, subtle registration character, and no thick universal keyline.
image_treatment.surface: Add faint paper tooth and controlled fine ink grain across broad fills while keeping headline edges, facial planes, and important text clean.
image_treatment.depth_and_light: Keep the scene orthographic, flat, and evenly illuminated; use adjacent hue changes rather than gradients, highlights, cast shadows, or 3D depth.

design_rules: Construct the cover from the masthead, paper rail, and hero silhouette before adding any small text or ephemera.
Use exactly one monumental side-profile subject and crop the subject at both the right and bottom edges.
Maintain the left-to-right density transition from exposed paper and black copy to densely layered warm and cool organic color masses.
Use at least thirty separate lobes in three scales, with warm inner lobes and larger cool outer lobes, without depicting a literal feather boa.
Keep five visibly distinct typography registers and make the four largest text elements readable.
Use exactly one black burst, one invented emblem, one line-art vignette, one non-scannable registration strip, and no extra sticker collection.
Keep the same asymmetric spine-and-profile hierarchy in landscape; do not add panels, equal columns, or a second subject.
Preserve style-level layout, palette, shape, and print behavior while changing every literal subject, prop, publication name, headline, story, and identity mark.
do: Use a strong directional side profile that faces into the editorial rail.
Crop the red masthead, colored mantle, and lower torso aggressively so the artwork feels larger than the page.
Keep broad flat swatches adjacent and let shape overlap imply depth.
Make the line-art vignette relate to the new case prop and keep the fictional emblem clearly non-national and non-branded.
Treat the visible text as designed editorial content with intentional line breaks, not random decoration.
avoid: No recognizable athlete, celebrity, football imagery, Norway reference, real publication logo, source slogans, source issue number, or matching costume.
No centered or fully contained hero, symmetrical grid, clean boxed sidebar, equal cards, conventional magazine spread, or generic banner.
No photorealistic portrait, photographic collage, painterly brushwork, anime, superhero comic ink, glossy 3D render, soft airbrush, or cinematic lighting.
No literal realistic feather boa, realistic flower bouquet, generic rainbow, pastel drift, smooth gradient modeling, glow, metallic finish, or drop shadow.
No heavy grunge, torn-paper collage, distressed photocopy field, muddy halftone, accidental sensor noise, illegible pseudo-language, or excessive stickers.
No watermark, username, platform mark, QR code, real scannable barcode, signature, national crest, team badge, or corporate identity.
